source_description: Name of Lithuania (written as Lietuwa ) in an old Lithuanian language book Biblia, tai esti: Wissas Szwentas Rásztas, Sēno ir Naujo Testamento, pagal Wokiszką Pérstáttimą D. M. Luteraus ... Lietuwiszkay pérstattytas, ir antra kartą iszspáustas (in Lithuanian language ), published in Königsberg in 1755.

caption: Vilniaus krašto verbomis prekiaujanti moteris.
author: Nežinomas
source_description: Vilnius resident selling Easter palms (plant branches for Palm Sunday) near the All Saints Church on the Rūdninkų Street in Vilnius in 1916.

caption: Trijų Karalių figūros Čezinatike, Italijoje.
author: Terragio67
source_description: The wooden statues of the Three Wise Men are on display in the "Paranza" boat. They are a part of the floating Nativity scene, which has the following recognition: “ Heritage of Italy for tradition ”, awarded by the italian Ministry of Tourism for “ Its capacity to preserve local customs and folklore... “.
